column1: # Expected is Quantity.formatted() or ERROR:kind. Every success must also read back through Quantity.parse.
# Precision: sums keep decimals, products keep significant figures, whole numbers are exact
# Units: + and - need the same unit (a plain number adopts it)
# Unsupported dimensional operations are errors, never a silently unitless number
# Non-finite and pathological input is rejected, not formatted
# round(x, n): half away from zero, never more decimals than a measured input had
